_: Kill-check for asc-6ola.3. The planning-time power check: the closed form and its inversion (Stage A, packages/analysis/src/power.ts), the command that reports them (Stage B), the one rendering of a Proportion that compare and power now share, and the flag parser that names the flag it refused. Each mutant breaks ONE thing and names the test that must notice. The killers were found by running the mutant and reading the failing names off `assertionResults`, not by guessing which test ought to care.
